card.name: The word steady in steady-state
card.fires_on: The word "steady" (or its first piece "Ste" + "ady") right before "-state" in pharmacokinetic text. It also fires weakly on "reach" ahead of "a new steady state".

modes.label: Steady before state
modes.description: The word steady that starts the term steady-state, usually about drug concentrations or exposure.

card.plain: It marks the word "steady" in "steady-state", the point where drug levels level off.
